purpose: Teach: 一豊/姫路/遡る/騒がせ/無口/高台/打線/東京ドーム

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、戦国大名、絶対、一豊、絶対、ゆかりの地、絶対、警察、絶対、警備しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've maintained security at this Sengoku-era site connected to Yamauchi Kazutoyo with the utmost dedication.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Slight formal weight on each phrase. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone stating fact and taking quiet responsibility for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 姫路、本気で、絶対、城、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご担当、絶対、ですか?本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you're the officer handling security at Himeji Castle?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, opening lighter. Respectful but direct. Leans forward slightly. The question of someone trying to understand the scope of the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件、本気で、絶対、遡る、絶対、と、絶対、長年の、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査が、絶対、関係しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. This case goes back quite far, and years of police investigation have all led here.
lines.style: Careful, methodical pacing. Words chosen with precision. A slight pause before 'investigation'—acknowledging the weight of time and effort behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: マスコミを、本気for、絶対、騒がせ、絶対、た、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、ご苦労でしたよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That media attention surrounding the incident must have made your job much harder.
lines.style: Sympathetic acknowledgment. Slower pace. Quiet recognition of difficulty. Eyes show genuine understanding—not performative empathy but the real thing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、本気で、絶対、無口、絶対、で、絶対、警察、絶対、聴取、絶対、進めにくいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The suspect has been uncooperative, which makes the interviews difficult to conduct.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Slight resignation in the breath. Professional tone—this is an obstacle stated plainly, not a complaint. Pause before 'difficult' to let the word land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、高台、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I hear patrols in the elevated areas have been increased.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation. Conversational but attentive. The tone of someone noticing detail and offering it as acknowledgment of thoroughness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、打線、絶対、関連の警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're also handling security for the pro baseball team's events and operations.
lines.style: Shift to slightly broader scope. Same measured tone but with a hint of additional breadth—the work extends beyond one case. Professional, steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 東京ドーム、本気で、絶対、で、絶対、の警備、絶対、警察、絶対、大変ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Security at the Tokyo Dome must be quite demanding.
lines.style: Appreciative, trailing off slightly. Genuine recognition of scale and difficulty. Warm but understated. The closing acknowledgment of someone honoring the work being done.
